about.title: About {site}
about.tagline: A commercial AI API gateway built for developers.
about.feature.gateway.title: One endpoint
about.feature.gateway.body: Chat, embeddings and multimodal calls share a single OpenAI-compatible entry point.
about.feature.protocols.title: Multiple protocols
about.feature.protocols.body: OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini compatible requests are translated to the right upstream.
about.feature.billing.title: Metered billing
about.feature.billing.body: Every request is metered against the calling token with transparent pricing.
about.feature.security.title: Scoped credentials
about.feature.security.body: Model, group and IP limits are enforced per API token, with hardened sessions.

home.hero.title: Every model. One endpoint. Every call metered.
home.hero.subtitle: NEWTG relays streaming requests to upstream providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, settles each call in integer credits, and keeps a record you can audit line by line.
home.features.title: Core capabilities
home.features.multi_upstream.title: Multi-upstream aggregation
home.features.multi_upstream.body: One endpoint reaches every configured provider. Priority and weight routing fail over to the next channel when one errors.
home.features.billing.title: Transparent credit billing
home.features.billing.body: Pre-authorise, reconcile, refund. Balances and per-call charges are integer credits you can check line by line.
home.features.streaming.title: Streaming and cross-protocol relay
home.features.streaming.body: SSE passes through untouched. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini requests are translated in both directions.
home.features.ratelimit.title: Rate limits and quotas
home.features.ratelimit.body: Caps per user, token, and model, with an explicit retry hint when a limit is hit.
home.features.stateless.title: Stateless cluster
home.features.stateless.body: Any replica serves any request. Configuration changes reach every instance in seconds, with no restart.
home.features.credentials.title: Credential governance
home.features.credentials.body: Provider credentials and API tokens are encrypted or hashed. No endpoint returns them in plaintext.
home.onboarding.title: Get started in three steps
home.onboarding.token_body: Create an API token in the console. It is shown once and stored as a hash.

models.glossary.title: How these numbers are measured
models.glossary.p50: P50 — half of requests finished faster than this.
models.glossary.p95: P95 — 95% of requests finished faster; the slow tail.
models.glossary.ttft: TTFT — time to first token, for chat models.
models.glossary.success_rate: Success rate — completed calls divided by all calls in the window.
models.glossary.sample: Sample — number of calls behind a number; fewer than 20 is marked low.
models.glossary.source_test: Measured test — a scheduled benchmark run, reporting P50 and P95.
models.glossary.source_usage: Live traffic average — the mean of real calls; it is not a percentile, so only one number is shown.
